en.headline: Hong Kong pairs set up all-SAR squash mixed doubles final
en.dek: Both Hong Kong mixed doubles combinations won their semi-finals on Saturday at the Asian Games, guaranteeing gold and silver for the city in the event.
body: Hong Kong’s two mixed doubles pairs both reached the final of the Asian Games squash competition on Saturday, ensuring an all-Hong Kong medal match and locking in gold and silver for the SAR.

Lee Ka-yi and Donald Tang advanced with a straight-games victory, while Toby Tse and Matthew Lai also progressed in straight games. With no bronze-medal match in the format, the two losing semi-finalists were already assured of medals; the final therefore decides only the colour of the top two places.
The all-Hong Kong final underlines the strength of the city’s squash programme at these Games and adds to a growing medal haul across multiple sports.

zh.headline: 亞運壁球混雙港隊包辦決賽 鎖定金銀牌
zh.dek: 港隊兩對混雙組合周六均打入亞運決賽，確保包辦金銀牌。
body: 名古屋亞運壁球混雙項目，港隊兩對組合周六均贏得半決賽，會師決賽，鎖定金銀牌。
李嘉兒與鄧家傑一對，以及謝詠恩與黎健文一對，均以直落兩局晉級。壁球賽事不設銅牌戰，半決賽負方已穩奪獎牌，決賽只會決定金銀牌誰屬。
港隊今屆亞運壁球項目繼續有所斬獲，兩對混雙晉身決賽顯示本地壁球實力。
